newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end higher after repo rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end higher after repo rate cut.

text.p: Portuguese bonds closed off highs after the central bank trimmed its repo rate by 10 basis points (bp) and dealers said the draining rate could drop by up to 50 bp on Monday.
"The market closed off highs after the repo rate cut. The expectation is that the Bank of Portugal will cut the draining and emergency lending rates on Monday," said a fixed rate director.
Another said: "If the cut in the draining rate is 20 to 30 bp, Portuguese Treasury bonds could rise further."
Money rates eased after the repo rate cut. Overnight and tomorrow/next closed at 6.95/7.00 percent, down from 7.05/7.10 percent in the morning.
